Marta L: Heads-up: opened PR to adjust SOC2 retention wording and add a short audit-logs export example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/436

Devin K: Paste the proposed paragraph?

Marta L: Draft: 

`Default audit-log retention: 90 days. Audit logs and operational telemetry are retained for security investigations and compliance. Customer content and customer-provided data are redacted by default and not used for model training, except where a customer has explicitly opted in under a written agreement. Enterprise customers may request extended retention.`

Samira (Legal): Replace "redacted by default" with "PII and sensitive identifiers are redacted by default; customers can supply additional redaction rules via the Console." Keep the opt-in clause. Also ask to add a link to /security/data-retention.

Devin K: I'll add a tiny JS snippet for export using the current SDK and a curl example.

docs-bot: CI: docs/lint passed for PR #436 :white_check_mark:

Marta L: Thanks — will push updates and merge after 24h if no objections.
